payload.content: A weighted base and felt pad are the details that make this 6.5-inch solid brass paper towel holder feel steady and countertop-safe while you tear off sheets. {FINISH_SENTENCE} Designed as a freestanding paper towel stand, the roll sits upright to help save counter space, and there’s no assembly required—just place it where you want it on the kitchen counter. The Carolina Collection blends contemporary lines with traditional design elements for a classic look that pairs easily with other classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware. Solid brass construction and a designer finish are specified for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Includes 1 paper towel holder and is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
